arguments.code:
import math
creds=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
spotify_pw=[c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0];
access_token=apis.spotify.login(username='ch-burch@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

# fetch all playlists in library (already known 5, but reusing fresh fetch for correctness)
page_limit=20
page_index=0
all_playlists=[]
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print('failure', page)
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))

# compute total duration per playlist
results=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    playlist_id=p['playlist_id']
    title=p.get('title')
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
    # pl['songs'] contains duration
    songs=pl.get('songs', [])
    total_seconds=sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    results.append({'playlist_id':playlist_id,'title':title,'song_count':len(songs),'total_seconds':total_seconds})

print('playlist_durations_seconds')
for r in results:
    print(r['playlist_id'], r['title'], 'songs', r['song_count'], 'total_seconds', r['total_seconds'])

shortest=min(results, key=lambda x: x['total_seconds'])
sec=shortest['total_seconds']
minutes=sec/60.0
# round to nearest whole number; half up
rounded=int(math.floor(minutes+0.5))
print('shortest_playlist', shortest['title'], 'minutes', minutes, 'rounded', rounded)
rounded
